text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the middle of our discussion about 
future plans, Dream Journey let out a 
sigh. She looked somewhat languid.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, excuse me. I'm quite alright. I was 
just thinking about what I should do to 
bring your plan to fruition..."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I will do my very best, more than ever 
before, to live up to your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I might be pushing Dream Journey too hard. 
I should probably review her upcoming race 
schedule.
